# With --output-htmx, a TemplateRoute builds the htmx attributes for its route:
# HTMX() starts the chain, Target, Swap, Trigger and PushURL set an attribute,
# and Attributes renders them with the verb attribute for the route's method.
# A route whose pattern names no method has no verb attribute, so it fails the
# render.

muxt generate --use-receiver-type=Server --output-htmx
muxt check

exec go test

-- template.gohtml --
{{define "GET /{$} Index()"}}<button {{(((.Path.Delete 7).HTMX.Target "#row").Swap "outerHTML").Attributes}}>x</button>{{end}}

{{define "GET /form Form()"}}<form {{(((.Path.Create).HTMX.Trigger "submit").PushURL "true").Attributes}}></form>{{end}}

{{define "GET /quote Quote()"}}<a {{((.Path.Delete 1).HTMX.Target `a"b<c`).Attributes}}>q</a>{{end}}

{{define "GET /bad Bad()"}}<a {{.Path.Ping.HTMX.Attributes}}>bad</a>{{end}}

{{define "DELETE /items/{id} Delete(id)"}}{{end}}

{{define "POST /items Create()"}}{{end}}

{{define "/ping Ping()"}}{{end}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Index() string     { return "" }
func (Server) Form() string      { return "" }
func (Server) Quote() string     { return "" }
func (Server) Bad() string       { return "" }
func (Server) Delete(id int) int { return id }
func (Server) Create() string    { return "" }
func (Server) Ping() string      { return "" }
-- template_test.go --
package server

import (
	"html/template"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func serve(t *testing.T, mux *http.ServeMux, target string) (int, string) {
	t.Helper()
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, target, nil))
	body, err := io.ReadAll(rec.Result().Body)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return rec.Code, string(body)
}

func TestRendered(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	for _, tt := range []struct {
		target, want string
	}{
		{"/", `<button hx-delete="/items/7" hx-target="#row" hx-swap="outerHTML">x</button>`},
		{"/form", `<form hx-post="/items" hx-trigger="submit" hx-push-url="true"></form>`},
		{"/quote", `<a hx-delete="/items/1" hx-target="a&#34;b&lt;c">q</a>`},
	} {
		code, body := serve(t, mux, tt.target)
		if code != http.StatusOK || !strings.Contains(body, tt.want) {
			t.Errorf("GET %s = %d %q, want 200 containing %q", tt.target, code, body, tt.want)
		}
	}
}

func TestUnsupportedMethodFailsTheRender(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	if code, body := serve(t, mux, "/bad"); code != http.StatusInternalServerError {
		t.Errorf("GET /bad = %d %q, want 500", code, body)
	}
}

func TestAttributesInGo(t *testing.T) {
	got, err := TemplateRoutePaths{}.Delete(7).HTMX().Target("#row").Attributes()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if want := template.HTMLAttr(`hx-delete="/items/7" hx-target="#row"`); got != want {
		t.Errorf("Attributes() = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
	if _, err := (TemplateRoutePaths{}).Ping().HTMX().Attributes(); err == nil {
		t.Error("Attributes() of a route without a method succeeded, want an error")
	}
}
